metaDescription: Order custom black shot glasses in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for bars, events, and branded giveaways.
introHtml: Black shot glasses offer a sleek, neutral canvas that makes your logo or message stand out with crisp contrast. Whether you need durable plastic options like the 1.5 oz Silipint® Silishot for outdoor events or classic glass styles for bar promotions, black lends itself well to screen printing or etching. Bulk buyers appreciate how black hides scratches and maintains a polished look through repeated use, making it a smart choice for high-traffic settings.
